**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks — targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire" and "personnel" surface nothing of the kind. § 12.3 goes further in our favour by expressly preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and confirming we have given no no-hire commitment. That is the playbook's preferred position, so nothing to change.

One adjacent note for the record: § 12.4 imposes a 24-month non-compete on Customer, which is a genuine concern but sits under the non-compete rule rather than this one, so I have not flagged the same term twice.
